title: Benefits Enrollment
text: Benefits Enrollment New hires get a window at the start. After that, changes wait for open enrollment or a qualifying life event such as a birth or a marriage. ## New hires New hires enroll in benefits within 30 days after the start date. Missing the new-hire benefits window means waiting for open enrollment unless there is a qualifying life event.

title: Dental and Vision
text: Dental and Vision Dental and vision sit beside the medical plan. You can elect them even if you waive medical. ## Dental Acme pays 100% of the employee dental premium. Acme pays 50% of the dependent dental premium. The dental annual maximum is $1,500 per person. ## Vision The vision exam allowance is once every 12 months. The vision frame allowance is $150. The employee vision premium is $10 per month.

title: Employee Assistance Program
text: Employee Assistance Program The EAP is a counseling benefit run by an outside vendor. Acme pays the invoice and does not see the notes. ## Counseling The employee assistance program includes 6 free counseling sessions per issue. ## Privacy EAP sessions are confidential and are not reported to the manager.

title: HSA and FSA
text: HSA and FSA An HSA and a healthcare FSA are not the same account, and they do not pair with every medical plan. Read the plan name before you elect one. ## HSA The Basic health plan is the HSA-eligible high deductible plan. Acme contributes $500 to an individual HSA and $1,000 to a family HSA each year. ## FSA The healthcare FSA annual limit at Acme is $3,300. Plus and Premium health plans can use the healthcare FSA, and

title: HSA and FSA
text: the Basic health plan cannot.

title: Learning Stipend
text: Learning Stipend Books, courses, and conference tickets that make you better at the job belong here. Team offsites do not. ## Amount The annual learning stipend is $1,500. ## Process Learning stipend requests above $200 are submitted in Workday before the purchase.

title: Life Insurance and Disability
text: Life Insurance and Disability Basic life and short-term disability are automatic. Buy-up life is optional and billed through payroll. ## Life Acme provides company-paid life insurance equal to 1 times annual salary. Employees may buy supplemental life insurance up to 4 times annual salary. ## Disability Short-term disability pays 60% of base pay for up to 12 weeks.

title: Open Enrollment
text: Open Enrollment Open enrollment is the annual chance to change medical, dental, vision, and the FSA. Elections lock in when the window closes. ## Dates Open enrollment for 2026 coverage runs from November 1 through November 15, 2025.

title: 401k Retirement Plan
text: 401k Retirement Plan The 401k is through the company plan. Match is based on eligible pay, and you can change the deferral in the plan site. ## Match Acme matches 100% of the first 4% of eligible pay. Acme matches 50% of the next 2% of eligible pay. A full company match requires the employee to contribute 6%, and Acme then contributes 5%. ## Vesting 401k vesting is 25% per year, and the employee is fully vested after 4 years.

title: 401k Retirement Plan
text: ## Enrollment Employees may enroll in the 401k on day 1.

title: Wellness, Internet, and Phone Stipends
text: Wellness, Internet, and Phone Stipends Wellness, home internet, and on-call phones are separate stipends. They do not come out of the learning budget. ## Wellness The monthly wellness stipend is $50. ## Internet Remote employees receive a home internet stipend of $60 per month. ## Phone On-call employees receive a phone stipend of $40 per month.

title: Corporate Card
text: Corporate Card The corporate card is for company spend. It is not a backup personal card that you sort out later. ## Statements Corporate card statements must be coded in the expense tool by the 5th business day of the next month. ## Personal charges Personal charges on the corporate card must be repaid within 10 business days.

title: Expense Approval
text: Expense Approval The approval chain depends on the amount. Pre-approval and the later expense report are different steps. ## Thresholds Expenses of $100 or less do not need pre-approval. Expenses from $100.01 through $1,000 require manager approval. Directors and Finance both approve an expense above $1,000.

text: Expense Limits Quick Reference Duplicate copy of expense-limits. The canonical page is the one with status current and this id. This file exists because the old wiki mirrored policies into a second folder. Spend company money as if finance will read the receipt out loud. Limits are per person, not per table, unless the line says otherwise. ## Meals The client dinner expense limit is $75 per person. The team meal expense limit is $35 per person. ## Travel meals

title: Mileage and Ground Transport
text: Mileage and Ground Transport Drive your own car only when it is the sensible way to the airport or a customer site. Log miles from the office or from home, whichever is shorter. ## Mileage The mileage reimbursement rate is $0.70 per mile. ## Rideshare Rideshare trips require a receipt when the fare is over $25.

title: Travel Policy
text: Travel Policy Book the boring option. The travel desk exists so a last-minute fare does not become your problem or finance's. ## Flights Book flights at least 14 days before departure when the trip is known that far ahead. ## Cabin Premium economy requires director approval on flights over 6 hours. ## Hotels Book hotels through the travel desk so the stay stays inside the city lodging per diem.

title: Bereavement and Jury Duty
text: Bereavement and Jury Duty These leaves are separate from PTO and sick time. Tell your manager as soon as you can; you do not need to share more detail than you want to. ## Bereavement Bereavement leave is 5 paid days for an immediate family member. Bereavement leave is 2 paid days for an extended family member. ## Jury duty Jury duty is paid for the full duration of the summons.

title: Code of Conduct
text: Code of Conduct We work with customers, vendors, and each other. The short version: be honest, skip the gray-area gift, and don't put a friend on a contract. ## Gifts The maximum value of a gift from a vendor is $50. ## Conflicts Employees must disclose a personal relationship with a vendor before any purchasing decision. ## Events A rideshare home from an Acme event with alcohol is reimbursed.

title: Harassment Reporting and Ethics
text: Harassment Reporting and Ethics You can report to your manager, to People, or straight to the ethics line. You do not have to have a perfect writeup to start. ## Reporting Report harassment to People or to ethics@acme.example. The ethics hotline is 1-800-555-0199. ## Retaliation Retaliation for a good-faith report is prohibited.

title: Company Holidays 2024
text: Company Holidays 2024 Superseded calendar. Kept because a few offer letters from that year still link here. The current holiday list is the 2025 policy. ## Fixed holidays The day after Thanksgiving is a company holiday in 2024 only on paper and was not observed. Acme observes 10 fixed company holidays in the old calendar.

title: Company Holidays 2025
text: Company Holidays 2025 The office is closed on the fixed holidays below. Floating holidays belong to the employee, not the team calendar. ## Fixed holidays Juneteenth is a company holiday in 2025. The day after Thanksgiving is a company holiday in 2025. Acme observes 11 fixed company holidays in 2025. ## Floating holidays Employees receive 2 floating holidays each calendar year. Floating holidays must be scheduled in Workday before November 15. ## The closed days Closed days in the current

title: Company Holidays 2025
text: year include New Year's Day, Martin Luther King Jr Day, Presidents Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Eve, and Christmas Day.

title: Internal Transfers
text: Internal Transfers Moving teams is normal. Doing it in the first months of a role usually is not, because the team that hired you is still ramping you. ## Eligibility Employees may request an internal transfer after 12 months in the current role. ## Process Internal transfers require a conversation with the current manager and the People partner.

title: Introductory Period
text: Introductory Period The first months are for learning the codebase and the customers. They are not a benefits waiting room. ## Timing The introductory period is 90 days. ## Benefits Benefits start on day 1, not after the introductory period.

title: Manager Guide to Time Off
text: Manager Guide to Time Off Approvals sit with the manager. People Ops watches the queue only when a request has been waiting. ## Approving requests Managers approve or decline PTO in Workday within 2 business days. ## First week Managers hold a first-week one-on-one within 3 business days of a new hire's start.

title: Parental Leave
text: Parental Leave Parental leave is paid and job-protected. Coordinate the dates with your manager early so the team can cover the work, and keep People in the thread. ## Length of leave The birth parent receives 16 weeks of paid parental leave. The non-birth parent receives 8 weeks of paid parental leave. An adoptive parent receives 12 weeks of paid parental leave. ## How to request Request parental leave in Workday under Time Off, using the Parental Leave type, at

title: Parental Leave
text: least 30 days before the expected start when the timing is foreseeable. Tell your manager and your HRBP about parental leave.

title: Performance Reviews
text: Performance Reviews Reviews are a written record of how the work went, not a surprise. Your manager owes you a draft before the calibration meeting. ## Cycle Performance reviews happen twice a year, in April and October. ## Ratings A performance rating of 3 is defined to mean the employee is meeting expectations. The performance rating scale runs from 1 to 4.

title: Paid Time Off Policy (2023)
text: Paid Time Off Policy (2023) Superseded on December 31, 2024. This page is kept so old links do not 404. Do not use it for a current balance. The questions people still paste into Slack are answered below with the 2023 numbers. ## Annual allotment During the first year of service, employees receive 12 PTO days per year. After 1 year of service, employees receive 12 PTO days per year. After 3 years of service, employees receive 16 PTO days

title: Paid Time Off Policy (2023)
text: per year. After 5 years of service, employees receive 20 PTO days per year. ## Carryover and accrual The maximum PTO carryover is 0 days. ## Questions people still ask Q: How many PTO days after 3 years? A: 16 PTO days. Q: What is the maximum PTO carryover? A: 0 days. Q: How many days a week did office-assigned employees work on site under this era? See the 2023 remote page, not this one.

title: Paid Time Off Policy
text: Paid Time Off Policy Paid time off is here so people actually rest. Tenure is measured from the full-time start date, and the current allotment below replaces every earlier intranet page. Managers should plan coverage before they approve a long stretch. ## Annual allotment During the first year of service, employees receive 15 PTO days per year. After 1 year of service, employees receive 18 PTO days per year. After 3 years of service, employees receive 22 PTO days per

title: Paid Time Off Policy
text: year. After 5 years of service, employees receive 25 PTO days per year. ## Carryover and accrual The maximum PTO carryover is 5 days. PTO accrues monthly and is posted on the first of each month. ## Requesting time off Request PTO in Workday at least 5 business days ahead when the request is for 2 or more days.

title: Remote and Hybrid Work (2023)
text: Remote and Hybrid Work (2023) Superseded remote policy. The on-site expectation and the stipend changed when the 2025 policy took effect. This copy remains because an old onboarding deck still links to it. ## On-site days Office-assigned employees work on site 4 days a week: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. ## Home office The one-time home office stipend is $250.

title: Remote and Hybrid Work
text: Remote and Hybrid Work Most roles are hybrid. The pattern below is the default for anyone assigned to an office. Fully remote is an exception with an owner, not a vibe. ## On-site days Office-assigned employees work on site 3 days a week: Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. ## Fully remote Fully remote work is available after 6 months with manager approval. ## Core hours Core collaboration hours are 10am to 3pm in the employee's local time zone. ## Home office

title: Remote and Hybrid Work
text: The one-time home office stipend is $500.

title: Sick Leave
text: Sick Leave Sick time covers illness and medical appointments. It is not a substitute for PTO and it is not a performance mark when it is used honestly. ## Allotment Employees receive 10 sick days per year, separate from PTO. Unused sick days are not paid out and do not carry over. ## Documentation A doctor's note is required after 3 consecutive sick days.

title: Working Hours and Overtime
text: Working Hours and Overtime Full-time work is a week, not a hero streak. Non-exempt teammates must be paid for extra hours, and exempt engineers are still expected to live inside a normal week. ## Schedule Standard full-time hours are 40 hours per week. ## Overtime Non-exempt overtime is paid at 1.5 times the base rate after 40 hours in a week. Overtime for non-exempt staff must be approved by the manager before it is worked. ## Classification Software engineers at

title: Working Hours and Overtime
text: Acme are classified as exempt.

title: First Week Checklist
text: First Week Checklist The first week is a checklist, not a vibe. Finish the items that unblock payroll, chat, and the badge before you start a project. ## Day 1 On day 1, pick up your badge and laptop from the office front desk or from the shipped kit. Complete 1Password and Slack setup on day 1. ## Manager Schedule a manager one-on-one within the first 3 business days.

title: IT Support
text: IT Support IT can reset a laptop, a badge, and an account. They cannot change a PTO balance. ## Contact IT support email is helpdesk@acme.example. ## Slack Urgent IT help is handled in the Slack channel it-help. ## Hours IT support hours are 8am to 6pm Central Time on business days.

title: Laptop Standard
text: Laptop Standard Everyone gets a standard build. Special hardware is for roles that compile or design all day, and it is requested, not assumed. ## Standard build The standard laptop is a 14 inch MacBook Pro or a 14 inch Dell XPS with 32 GB of memory and a 512 GB drive. ## Upgrades Laptop upgrades beyond the standard build require IT approval and a manager note. ## Refresh Laptops are replaced on a 3 year cycle.

title: Passwords and Multifactor Authentication
text: Passwords and Multifactor Authentication Passwords live in the company manager. Reuse and short passwords are the two ways accounts actually get popped. ## Length Passwords must be at least 14 characters. ## Manager Acme uses 1Password as the company password manager. ## Rotation Passwords are rotated every 180 days. ## MFA Multifactor authentication is required for every company application. ## Reuse Employees may not reuse any of their last 8 passwords.

title: Remote and Hybrid Work (IT copy)
text: remote Fully remote work is available after 6 months with manager approval. ## Core hours Core collaboration hours are 10am to 3pm in the employee's local time zone. ## Home office The one-time home office stipend is $500.

title: Security Training
text: Security Training Security training is short and mandatory. The phishing drills are practice, and reporting one is the outcome Security wants. ## Deadline New hires finish security training within 5 business days after the start date. ## Phishing Phishing drills are run by Security about once a quarter, and reporting a drill is never punished.

title: Software Catalog
text: Software Catalog These tools are already licensed. Ask before you put a new vendor on a card. ## Standard tools The standard software catalog includes Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, GitHub, Figma, 1Password, and Workday. ## Extra software Extra software with a fee above $200 needs manager approval in the IT portal.

title: VPN Access
text: VPN Access The VPN is required off the office network. Do not invent a gateway hostname from an old screenshot. ## Client The VPN client is Cisco AnyConnect. ## Gateway The VPN gateway hostname is vpn.acme.example. ## Access VPN access requires multifactor authentication.

title: About Acme
text: About Acme Acme is a mid-size software company. The product helps operations teams move work across tools without a pile of custom scripts. ## Company Acme Co was founded in 2014. ## Product Acme builds Acme Flow, a workflow product for mid-market operations teams. ## Size Acme has about 420 employees.

title: Handbook Glossary
text: Handbook Glossary Short definitions for the acronyms the rest of the handbook uses without explaining. ## Terms PTO means paid time off. HRBP means the Human Resources business partner assigned to a team. M&IE means meals and incidental expenses. HDHP means high deductible health plan.

title: Key Contacts
text: Key Contacts Use these inboxes before you guess a person's direct email from a conference slide. Leadership emails below are the public internal addresses. ## Leadership The CEO is Priya Raman, and her email is priya.raman@acme.example. The Head of People is Luis Ortega, and his email is luis.ortega@acme.example. The CFO is Helen Cho, and her email is helen.cho@acme.example. ## Inboxes Payroll email is payroll@acme.example.

title: Offices
text: Offices Three offices. Austin is the headquarters. Badges from one office work at the others. ## Austin The Austin headquarters address is 600 Congress Avenue, Suite 1800, Austin, TX 78701. ## Chicago The Chicago office address is 233 South Wacker Drive, Suite 5400, Chicago, IL 60606. ## Denver The Denver office address is 1801 California Street, Suite 900, Denver, CO 80202. ## Reception Reception hours are 8:30am to 5:00pm local time.

title: Payroll
text: Payroll Pay is biweekly. If a deposit looks wrong, write payroll with the pay period and a screenshot before you post in a large channel. ## Schedule The pay schedule is biweekly on Fridays. ## Direct deposit Set up direct deposit in Workday by the Wednesday before the first payday.

title: Teams
text: Teams Chapters and guilds are not separate headcount, so they are not listed here. ## List The teams at Acme are Platform, Product, Design, People, Finance, Customer Success, Security, and Marketing. ## Customer Success Customer Success sits in Austin and Chicago.

title: Visitors and Badges
text: Visitors and Badges Customers and candidates sign in. A visitor without a host does not get past reception. ## Badges Visitors sign in at reception and wear a paper badge for the entire visit. ## Escort A host employee must escort a visitor outside the reception area.
